drawer-custom.description: Online consultation of articles from several thousand electronic scientific journals available in full text as well as databases.

info-card.title: "Research never stops"
info-card.p1: BiblioMap reflects the reals time CNRS members accessing digital resources through the bibCNRS portal. This digital tool provides access to the full text of articles from several thousand electronic scientific journals and to bibliographic databases.
info-card.img1-alt: BibCNRS, the CNRS portal for access to electronic documentary resources
info-card.img1-caption: The platforms of specialized access portals are managed by Inist-CNRS.
info-card.p2: The visualizations available in BiblioMap are made possible through the use of ezPAARSE, an open-source software developed by l'Inist-CNRS and Couperin
info-card.comment: Note: the location of consultations shown on the map is deliberately approximate.
